subject: radiology
title: Anticoagulation and consent in IR

steps.tx: Blood thinners pause by risk. **SIR bleeding-risk categories** sort low, moderate and high-risk procedures guiding drug holds. **Direct oral anticoagulants** pause one to two days by renal function and risk. **Bridging heparin** suits mechanical valves, rarely others. **Restart plans** written before procedures prevent forgotten resumption.
steps.say: Blood thinners pause by risk. Bleeding-risk categories sort procedures guiding drug holds. Oral anticoagulants pause by renal function and risk. Bridging suits mechanical valves, rarely others. Written restart plans prevent forgotten resumption.

steps.tx: Platelets and knives coordinate. **Dual antiplatelets** continue through low-risk work but pause for high-risk punctures with cardiology. **Neuraxial rules** forbid spinal work on dual drugs. **Aspirin alone** continues through most IR. **Stent thrombosis** fears outweigh groin oozing where cardiology advises continuing.
steps.say: Platelets and knives coordinate. Dual tablets continue through low-risk work but pause for high-risk sticks with cardiology. Spinal work forbids dual drugs. Aspirin alone continues through most IR. Stent clot fears outweigh groin oozing.

steps.tx: Consent respects Montgomery. **Material risks** a reasonable patient would weigh include death, stroke and organ loss. **Montgomery disclosure** replaces doctor-knows-best with patient-centred choice. **Alternatives with no treatment** frame honest options including waiting. **Documented discussions** with names and risks protect patients and teams.
steps.say: Consent respects Montgomery. Material risks a reasonable patient would weigh include death, stroke and organ loss. Patient-centred choice replaces doctor-knows-best. Alternatives with waiting frame honest options. Documented discussions protect everyone.

steps.tx: Capacity and children need careful care. **Gillick competence** lets mature minors consent where understanding proves. **Best interests** guide adults lacking capacity with family input. **Language barriers** need interpreters, never relatives, for consent. **Second opinions** offered where stakes run high reassure.
steps.say: Capacity and children need care. Mature minors consent where understanding proves. Best interests guide incapacitated adults with family input. Language barriers need interpreters, never relatives. High stakes offer second opinions.
